reviews.title: Need some work
reviews.text:
I like the app so far. It definitely encourages my 9yo to use to do her chores. I like that I can add chores and make adjustments, but options are limited for customization on the app. You can also add rewards which is cool. I allowed my kids to make up their own rewards which just led to them wanting to fill more chores.
Down side: my 7yo doesn’t have a phone and uses mine to complete her chores. In this mode she can’t take photos for her chores. I don’t want her to complete chores as me because she has access to all parental things at that point.
-maybe add a lock code for switching profiles. 

The app has a bunch of potential. Just not quite perfect yet. Minimal latency between the coils finishing chores in their phone and when the parent gets a notification. 
Super user friendly

reviews.title: Was Working….
reviews.text: Until it wasn’t. All of a sudden, chores that should have been repeating daily have randomly started disappearing for the entire family. No warning, no reason. It’s a shame as we rely so much on apps like these as our entire family suffers from ADHD. I can no longer trust in this app.

reviews.title: Please allow people to use the free version
reviews.text: I had no option but to accept a free trial I didn’t want. What’s the point of using the free trial? I am not going to pay $50 a year for this when I haven’t even used the free version. Please change this and allow for a way to back out of the free trial and use the free version first.

reviews.title: Just needs one more thing
reviews.text: The app is great. My kids agent motivated to do chores and get stars. Especially redeeming rewards. The only thing I ask is to add a widget so they can have on their phone and see how many stars they have and what chores needs to be completed. Seeing a widget would keep up the motivation and also be a reminder!

reviews.title: My kids are finally doing chores
reviews.text: I just got this app set up and the kids are loving it. I love the options of rewards and the ease of adding in chores. I have a Cozyla calendar and my kids are able to use this app on the android device while I’m able to update stuff on my iPhone, the cross platform is amazing. I would love to be able to add widgets to my Cozyla calendar (android), one that is a chore chart for one kid and a list that shows each kid would be cool too! Please tell me widgets are coming soon 🙏🏼

reviews.title: Love this app!
reviews.text: We’ve been using Chorly for a couple weeks now and love it! The kids look forward to completing their chores and it has GREATLY reduced my need to nag them. I did submit one suggestion via email, but I think a full list view of chores would be useful so you don’t have to scroll through the calendar. Anyway, I think that one thing would truly make this app perfect!

reviews.title: Really enjoying, but missing one thing…
reviews.text:
So my family has been using Chorly for a few months now and it’s been working great for us: not only does the small one get their work done, but in a household with an Autistic wife and ADHD husband this really helps us assign things out neatly and clearly to each other. 

But it comes with the downside of having to always click into the app.

Yes, there are notifications, but it just sort of ominously tells you “a chore” is coming up due, not what chore specifically. That alone would be a nice change, but what would make this the best of the apps I’ve worked with is a single thing: a widget. Just a little widget to sit there on my phone so I can tick things off and they can be more visual.

You guys are 🤏 this close to being perfect. That widget would push it there. :)

reviews.title: Chorly why did you have to do this
reviews.text: Chorly is really good for parents to believe you when you do your chores but a feature that I don’t like is when you earn a reward your stars reset making you have to start your journey all over again and it’s just so frustrating for rewards that require a lot of stars I mean a LOT, so its better to save your stars when you have like 50,000 or something, it might take an extremely long time, but it’ll be worth it.

reviews.title: Awesome concept. Needs some features
reviews.text:
I absolutely love this app first off. Don’t get my review wrong for putting it at 4 stars. The things I have noticed that I would like to see fixed or added are.
- Allow a 2nd parent to not just edit but admin the chores as well. If my child sends a request to complete a chore, allow either parent to approve it and really interact with the child. 
- chat of some sort. A way to cheer each family member on to complete their chores and give a high five when doing well. 
- ability to take away stars/points same day. Sometimes a chore was completed like cleaned bedroom but then later in the day they mess it up again. 
- see all chores assigned to your family members. Not just the ones on certain days. 
- allow all family members to collaborate on job duties if needed. Some chores are too big for one person. 

These are just a few. Hope to see some added soon. Would maybe make the $50 yearly price tag a lot more reasonable. Thanks

reviews.title: LOVE IT
reviews.text:
Absolutely love this app. Makes everything simple and easy. My kids loved it on the first day. My youngest wanted to add extra chores to earn more stars so she asked to wash my dishes!! 

I’d like to ask or suggest if we are able to add maybe a calendar view so I can easily see a month overview. I’d also would love it if we could do scheduling with “every other day or every other week” so I can alternate certain tasks with my children. Also would like to take off the “add chore” feature on my children’s account but I know that’s an easy work around. 

Other than that! The app is wonderfully put together and straightforward. It’s getting my oldest into doing the chores and my youngest excited to help out

reviews.title: Feature suggestion
reviews.text: Loving the app so far! I have a feature suggestion, or maybe I'm missing something. My wife accepted a chore and accidentally doubled the stars for our son, so a 10-star task gave him 20 instead. It would be helpful if she could go back after approval and correct the mistake, returning it to the original 10 stars. Is there a way for the admin to adjust the stars after a chore has been marked as completed? If not, this feature would be a great addition.

reviews.title: They ask for more chores
reviews.text: This app has been a lifesaver! My kids, 13 and 16, actually ask for more chores to earn rewards. Chorly’s competitive aspect works wonders, and the support team is quisk to assist. Perfect for any busy family!

reviews.title: This really helped us
reviews.text: I love how Chorly encourages my kids to do chores. My daughter now actually walks the dog and cleans her room properly to earn gift cards that I buy for her through the app. The proof and approval feature is fantastic for busy parents like me!

reviews.title: Good
reviews.text: As a mom of three, this app is a game changer! It's simple enough for my 5-year-old to use since they have view for small kids who don't have phones, and the rewards system motivates all of them without. Chorly has made our chaotic routine manageable and even enjoyable!

reviews.title: Game on!
reviews.text: It’s just my husband and me, and despite having no children, we find ourselves competing for the most points in Chorly to keep our house clean. We’re still unsure what the prize will be, but I’d love a spa day!
